materials.summary_zh: 原本计划去海边，结果下雨了。一家人在家度过了意外愉快的一天。（虚构故事）

segments.en: Last Saturday, my family planned a trip to the beach.
segments.zh: 上周六，我们一家计划去海边玩。

segments.en: We packed sandwiches, towels and a big umbrella.
segments.zh: 我们带好了三明治、毛巾和一把大伞。

segments.en: But when we woke up, it was raining heavily.
segments.zh: 可是我们醒来时，外面正下着大雨。

segments.en: My little brother was very disappointed, and he started to cry.
segments.zh: 我弟弟非常失望，哭了起来。

segments.en: So my mum had an idea.
segments.zh: 于是妈妈想了个主意。

segments.en: We moved the sofa, put the towels on the floor and had a picnic in the living room.
segments.zh: 我们挪开沙发，把毛巾铺在地上，在客厅里野餐。

segments.en: After lunch, we played board games and watched an old film together.
segments.zh: 午饭后，我们一起玩桌游，看了一部老电影。

segments.en: In the evening, the rain stopped and we saw a rainbow over the houses.
segments.zh: 傍晚雨停了，我们看到房子上空出现了一道彩虹。

segments.en: My brother said it was the best beach day ever, even without the beach.
segments.zh: 弟弟说这是他过得最好的“海边日”，虽然根本没去海边。

glossary.zh: 打包；装好（pack 的过去式）
醒来（wake up 的过去式）

glossary.note_zh: the best ... ever = 有史以来最好的

questions.explanation_zh: 原文：my family planned a trip to the beach.
原文：had a picnic in the living room.

materials.title_zh: 通知：山坡图书馆的变化
materials.summary_zh: 一家社区图书馆贴出的通知：开放时间、新服务和注意事项。（虚构的通知）

segments.en: From 1 March, Hillside Library will have new opening hours.
segments.zh: 从 3 月 1 日起，山坡图书馆将实行新的开放时间。

segments.en: We will open at 9 am and close at 7 pm from Monday to Friday.
segments.zh: 周一至周五，上午 9 点开门，晚上 7 点关门。

segments.en: On Saturdays, we will close earlier, at 4 pm.
segments.zh: 周六会提前在下午 4 点关门。

segments.en: The library will be closed on Sundays.
segments.zh: 周日闭馆。

segments.en: There is also some good news: you can now borrow up to ten books at a time.
segments.zh: 还有一个好消息：现在每次最多可以借十本书。

segments.en: You can keep them for three weeks.
segments.zh: 可以借三周。

segments.en: Our new study room on the first floor is free for all members.
segments.zh: 二楼新开的自习室对所有会员免费开放。

segments.en: Please book a table at the front desk before you use it.
segments.zh: 使用前请在前台预约座位。

segments.en: Please remember that food is not allowed in the reading areas.
segments.zh: 请记住，阅读区内禁止饮食。

segments.en: If you have any questions, please ask our staff.
segments.zh: 如有任何问题，请咨询工作人员。

glossary.note_zh: 英式英语 ground floor 是一楼，first floor 是二楼。

questions.explanation_zh: 原文：On Saturdays, we will close earlier, at 4 pm.

questions.explanation_zh: 原文：borrow up to ten books at a time.

materials.summary_zh: 两个同事聊周末打算做什么，并约好一起去看展。

segments.speaker: Mark
segments.en: Have you got any plans for the weekend, Jenny?
segments.zh: 珍妮，你周末有什么安排吗？

segments.speaker: Jenny
segments.en: Yes, I'm going to visit my grandparents on Saturday.
segments.zh: 有，我周六要去看我的祖父母。

segments.speaker: Jenny
segments.en: They live in a village about an hour from here.
segments.zh: 他们住在离这儿大约一小时车程的村子里。

segments.speaker: Mark
segments.en: That sounds nice. Are you going by train?
segments.zh: 听起来不错。你坐火车去吗？

segments.speaker: Jenny
segments.en: No, I'm going to drive. What about you?
segments.zh: 不，我开车去。你呢？

segments.speaker: Mark
segments.en: I'm not sure yet. I might go to the new photo exhibition on Sunday.
segments.zh: 我还没定。周日可能去看那个新开的摄影展。

segments.speaker: Jenny
segments.en: Oh, I want to see that too! Is it expensive?
segments.zh: 哦，我也想去！贵吗？

segments.speaker: Mark
segments.en: No, it's free on Sundays.
segments.zh: 不贵，周日免费。

segments.speaker: Jenny
segments.en: Shall we go together? I'll be back by Sunday morning.
segments.zh: 我们一起去吧？我周日上午就回来了。

segments.speaker: Mark
segments.en: Great idea. Let's meet outside the museum at two o'clock.
segments.zh: 好主意。我们两点在博物馆门口见吧。

glossary.note_zh: be going to + 动词原形：表示已经打算好的事。

questions.explanation_zh: 原文：I'm going to visit my grandparents on Saturday.
原文：No, I'm going to drive.
原文：Let's meet outside the museum at two o'clock.

materials.summary_zh: 一位乘客在火车上丢了手机，到车站的失物招领处询问。

segments.speaker: Clerk
segments.en: Good afternoon. How can I help you?
segments.zh: 下午好。有什么可以帮您？

segments.speaker: Passenger
segments.en: Hi. I think I left my phone on the train this morning.
segments.zh: 你好。我好像今天早上把手机落在火车上了。

segments.speaker: Clerk
segments.en: I'm sorry to hear that. Which train were you on?
segments.zh: 很遗憾。您坐的是哪一班车？

segments.speaker: Passenger
segments.en: The 8:15 from Bridgeton. I got off here at nine.
segments.zh: 布里奇顿发车的 8 点 15 分那班。我九点在这儿下的车。

segments.speaker: Clerk
segments.en: What does your phone look like?
segments.zh: 您的手机是什么样子的？

segments.speaker: Passenger
segments.en: It's black, and it has a green case with a small star on the back.
segments.zh: 黑色的，套着绿色手机壳，背面有一颗小星星。

segments.speaker: Clerk
segments.en: Let me check. Someone brought in two phones today.
segments.zh: 我查一下。今天有人送来两部手机。

segments.speaker: Clerk
segments.en: Is this one yours?
segments.zh: 这部是您的吗？

segments.speaker: Passenger
segments.en: Yes, that's it! Thank you so much.
segments.zh: 对，就是它！太感谢了。

segments.speaker: Clerk
segments.en: You're welcome. Can you sign this form, please?
segments.zh: 不客气。请您在这张表上签个字。

glossary.zh: 落下；遗留（leave 的过去式）
下车（get off 的过去式）

glossary.note_zh: What does it look like? = 它是什么样子的？

glossary.zh: 送来；拿进来（bring in 的过去式）
